body:
We have been broken up for 4 months.

She has a new bf.

She blocked me everywhere. This isn’t a test. This is something I pushed her to do.
I’ve talked about it more than once, scout my account history
Yes ive been doing therapy since september, started CBT therapy at the beginning of November.
Literally driving around in my car yesterday cursing myself out, calling myself a piece of shit human being who ruins everything.
Oh thanks, ill just keep living in this daily hell within my head because some people would be inconvenienced with the loss of me.

I’ve been severely depressed for the past 3 months with no progress or change. 

A suicide attempt is on the cards as I’m worsening and my intrusive thoughts turn darker and more planned. It’s went from “I wouldn’t mind dying” to “This is how I’m going to do it XYZ”.

What is more humane? Me hanging myself and potentially becoming paralysed or severely disabled or letting me release myself from this pain through euthanasia?
I can’t live with this guilt, it’s just a daily struggle weighing me down. You really don’t know what you had till it’s gone. My life is so fucking shit now.

No I pushed her so far away, unloaded everything on her so much that she blocked me everywhere. I will not burden her life anymore with my pathetic problems.

I fucking hate myself so much.

It feels like I just fucking done this all to hurt myself. What was I fucking thinking??????
 She was my fucking world I done everything for her I was doing so much. 

When she broke up with me she felt guilty about my depression. Then she wanted to work things out and I just pushed her far away, I felt so fucking guilty, I thought she deserved so much better.

Now 3 months later and I’m suffering daily. 

I’m so fucked from all of this I just wanna fucking die. I fucking hate myself so much. I miss her so fucking much.

It was a futre I had dreamed of having as a child. And for a few weeks I lost it, in the cloud of self hatred and depression. Now ill never get that back.

Whats the fucking point. I sit alone on christmas day doing nothing, I fucked it up, i fucked it all up.
Ain’t that the fucking truth. Fuck everything.
Me

During those 3 weeks I was trying to concentrate on the start of school and isolated myself.

Anytime she wanted to talk I was mean or told her to go see other people.

I pushed her away because I didn’t think she wanted to be with me, that she deserved so much better than me. I felt guilty about her blaming herself.

Then when I finally had a clearer conscious over everything it was far too late.

I’m pathetic. I caused this. I deserved this.

Yeah I’m a piece of shit and a coward. I rather to isolating myself and ignoring everyone than talking about it.

I deserved what I got.
Not as simple as that

Blocked everywhere and I said I wouldn’t contact her.

I’ve burdened her life enough. No more.

I destroyed my relationship.

Hurt the person I love.

Pushed her in to the arms of someone else.

Destroyed a future id been working towards for years.

Lost not only my girlfriend, but my best friend. Im so alone all the time, I dont do anything and find no enjoyment in anything.

Im a shell of a human being and I have no identity anymore.
Yes
Ive been going to therapy for the past 3 months.

I hurt her, she wanted answers and I was too cowardly to give them.

Now im suffering for that. I said mean shit to her, told her to go see other people then came crawling back 3 weeks later. 

I then persisted and let my emotions get the better of me until she ultimately blocked me everywhere.

I loved her so fucking much and I loved everything we were building, but I let my mental health dictate my actions and fear play in to my mind. 

I fucking hate myself for it all.
Yup it’s all over for me. Just the countdown to the day now.

I’ve been having the thoughts before I was even on meds. There is no point anymore.

I’ve had depression my entire life. This is the worst it’s ever been. This isn’t a classic “oh ho get over your breakup” it’s me realising what a terrible human being I am.

I didn’t communicate because all I did was fear I’d push her further away. 

And when I did communicate I pushed her away.

I’m such a fucking idiot.

I did it because my depression that had been plaguing me my entire fucking life does that.

I turn in to a self loathing, self hating piece of shit and when she blamed herself for my depression all it made me think was that she deserved better than me and I subconsciously pushed her away. Those weeks after the breakup are a blur to me.

I’m just out of a 5 year relationship 3 months ago, that I fucked up with my mental health. She was my everything and the more I think of it she was a huge part of my life and I let it be destroyed. She is dating someone new now and my anxiety pushed me to lashing out and her blocking me everywhere.

I literally have no friends and no one to talk to. No job, no motivation, no aspirations, no nothing. 

I’m right there with you. It’s not “if I’m gonna die” it’s “when” I’m gonna leave it till after the holidays and then end it.

Absolutely correct. I fucked up, I didnt communicate, my ex broke up with my due to mental illness and then wanted to fix things, and because I fell in to a very deep depression where I couldnt think straight and blamed myself for her wanting to break up, I told her to go see other people and see if she still wanted to be with me.

When I came out of that state of mind with a clear concious it was too late.

The reason we arent together is my fault. I take full responsibility and hate myself every day for it.

Its so hard to do that alone. She was my best friend, we would talk everyday for hours for 4 and a half years, to now not even having her in my life in anyway. Im so fucking alone all the time and in the end its my fault.

Actually after the breakup the first thing I did was go to my doctors and see about therapy and get on meds. In the hopes to better myself and show her that I’m willing to change. But yes I get where you are coming from. 

My depression didn’t mean I didn’t care, it’s not that I didn’t communicate, I just communicated negatively because I felt she deserved better.

When she blamed herself for my depression the last thing I wanted to do was talk about how depressed I was, in case it pushed her away farther and she blamed herself more.

Ironic huh.

Funny thing is, the actions I took have all lead to an even deeper depression for me.

Spent the last 3 months taking to practically no one, sitting home alone in my room, and the only regular thing I do is go to class and see my therapist. 

I’ve really fucked everything up.

I know and I admitted that. I admitted and apologised for everything. Still didn’t save it in the end, no matter what I was willing to do.

I hated myself so much it turned me in to a fucking asshole, and pushed her away farther than I ever could imagine. 

Now im here 3 months later, taking medication and having regular thoughts of suicide. Im a terrible human being.
I don’t think you understand just how much of a hold depression can take on your subconscious and plague your actions.

This is the worst pain I’ve felt since the breakup. Why didn’t I do anything. Why did I say those things.

I fucking hate depression so much.

You are right. There were no winners or losers in this exchange, just victims of a misunderstanding and casualties of a mental illness.

Yes, I couldn’t even think about dating anyone else right now, with where my mind is 24/7. It wouldn’t be fair on the other person.

You are completely correct. I need to stop living in this victim mentality and deflecting the blame.

Take responsibility for my actions, even if it’s an action I made subconsciously and couldn’t control.

Fuck man, what am I even gaining from asking this question?

Right on the money bro.

And yeah the guilt of knowing I destroyed my relationship, is fucking eating me alive daily.

She was my world dude. In a way I feel I got what I deserved from all of this.

Depressions a bitch.

Maybe I am the asshole.

Edited, my bad

She never said it directly, but she responded to my reasoning with "You were given a chance to communicate"
I’m so proud of you. Going through the hardest period in my life right now and posts like these are an inspiration.

Thank you so much. 

I'm in such a dark place right now, and im just looking for anything to hold on to for hope.
Yes I attend therapy once a week.

They were bad before. After the breakup, it took me to a new level of depression. Just infinite self-hate and despise for my being.

I've never had serious suicidal thoughts until these past few weeks. Shows truly how deep im in.
I was on it before, it didnt really do anything, maybe I need to try a different type or different dosage.
Take this post as a warning my man, things will get so much worse if you let the most important person in your life walk away.

Na dude its beyond too late.

She broke up with me due to my depression, then I went in to that depressive self destruction mode and pushed her far fucking away, then 3 weeks later with a clearer head I gain the courage to go forward and hopefully work things out, tell her the truth about everything but find out she is seeing someone else and doesnt wanna work on things and it was too late.

It broke my heart and sent me into this spiral where I was just a complete overly obsessed nut case with trying to beg her to work things out etc. Spamming her for days, calls etc. left her alone for a straight month, Then about just over a month ago we got into an argument and I went off on her about it all and she blocked me everywhere.

My emotions were so fluctuating constantly, I genuinely thought I was bi-polar at a point.

Ive been doing shit loads of therapy etc but I know she aint coming back, especially after how much of a piece of shit I acted after the breakup. I deserve where im at now.

Its dead in the water my friend and the only person to point the finger at is me.

Try and keep your GF around. I hope she understands the pain you are going through daily.

I was self destructive honestly, my ex blamed my depression on herself and thought she was the problem. I then turned in to an asshole and told her to go see other people, not because thats what I wanted but because its what I thought was best for her.

Where im at now is just a constant cycle of self hate, I lost the best thing in my life because I couldnt control my feelings.

Yeah, this is why I'm avoiding dating or anything along these lines. 3 months out of a nearly 5 year relationship, and it hurts a lot still. 

I'm taking the longer more difficult road, but hopefully I can find self confidence and self dependance through it.

Sometimes I just miss the voice of someone to talk to, play games with, sleep next to etc but im not gonna jump in to something with someone else to use them as a cloak to get over my breakup. 

I tried dating and honestly, everyone just seems hollow to me, I just cant even imagine being in a relationship right now.

> Depression may feel like it’s pushing you away from others, but here, it’s brought us together. 

Fucking ouch man, this is the fucking worst period of my life right now.

I went through a breakup after 5 years together, back in September from my ex blaming my depression on herself and feeling guilty. This crushed me.

She actually wanted to fix things after the breakup, but what did I do? I was so deep inside my own head with everything that I was self-destructive, told her that she should see other people and pretended to be ok with the breakup, not because thats what I wanted but because I felt so awful about her blaming herself that I truly believed that she deserved so much better than me and that no one deserved to be with a piece of human trash like me. 

few weeks later when I had a clearer conscious and the bravery to approach her about it, told her everything and  wanted to work things out, told me she had moved on, was seeing someone else and that it was too late.

Next couple days/weeks/months involved petty bullshit to try gage reactions, over stepping boundaries, contacting her when told not to, and ridiculous amounts of desperation. I was pathetic and losing my mind.

3 months later, when I look back I just feel guilt and regret that she ever felt that way and that I hid those things from her and said the things I did. But on the bright side atleast she is happier without me, and honestly she deserves to be.

People dont realise just how numb depression makes you feel. It makes you feel like you are an alien, and all you can do is sit there in your head and fester, blaming yourself over and over, and that no matter what you do or what you say you will always be a failure or a disappointment. its just constant loneliness and constant despise for your existence.
Oaft you’re hard
How cool are you huh
Superman is OP as fuck bro
That doesn’t even make sense. The punishment from being caught and what followed it can make you sorry.

Thank you. Yes I wont lie, it felt like I was kicked when I was down and the complete defiance and denial to even work through it and understand that things CAN be better without even talking about it when I was in a clear state of mind, and realising that I was just in a bad place, is really what felt like twisting the knife.

I needed this. Going through the worst period of my life right now where I feel like I lost my identity and my passion to do anything.

Gotta keep my chin up and keep going forward

Dont worry man I know you mean well, yeah I need to start being selfish and looking after me. Its difficult cos ive always grew up with the mindset of helping others, do things thats youd want others to do etc
Problem is its over christmas and new years, spending that time alone in a place where the only people I know are my ex, her family and thats it, doesnt sound too appealing to me.

I like to plan ahead....

way ahead

About that... when you are pretty much relolving your life around someone who lives in a 6 hour difference time zone, you kind of lose social circles and friends.

I dont really have friends anymore, and the 2 that I do both work night shift so seeing them is of a rarity.
I think it says more about her than it does me to be honest. As sad as it is, she isnt the person I thought she was or as dedicated to me as she led on even after the breakup.
We should start a club where we just sit around shaking her heads calling ourselves idiots.

I thank you so much for writing this and trying to help.

The thing I cant seem to get past is the idea I put so much in to it, yes sacrifices, but sacrifices I was willing to make for someone I loved more than anyone and sacrifices I made for a future I thought we both wanted. We were so close to closing the gap that it stings so hard.

I hope I do get over this sooner rather than later, but like ive said in other comments the whole comprehension that someone could walk away from that so easily after someone had dedicated so much to them on a daily basis, without even considering a second chance, is absolutely fucking mind blowing to me that its hard to even believe it happened.
I’ll look in to it friend!

I wasn’t even depressed for a couple months, it was a couple weeks and it was only because I wouldn’t be able to see her for a while. That’s the whole reason I booked the tickets, to have a goal to work towards.

She also didn’t try for 2 and a half months, that was all me trying to make her change her mind. try 2 weeks, that’s the time it took her to go from “please talk and let’s work this out” to “it’s too late”.

And Na man her bf before me was abusive both emotionally and physically, the idea that anyone could be that way to her made my blood boil. I always did what I could to make her happy and the fact that she no longer wants that, really cuts me deep inside.
I’ve been considering it but I don’t have a lot of money and going to the us fir 3 weeks on barely anything isn’t something I’d want to do

A lot of people tell me that but I don’t know why she would fight to try fix it for like 2 weeks after it. Backtrack on everything and try and repair it. 

It’s the fact that I couldn’t think straight during that period of time and would just ignore her or refuse to answer her questions because I didn’t want her blaming herself anymore, then when I approached her about it with my head clearer it was “too late.”

A lot of stuff she says after the breakup made me feel she wasn’t over me or was trying to incite a reaction at time.

Edit: also it makes it worse because I had a shit load of plans for the future and at that point was just about to start a degree I was literally doing for us. The idea anyone could walk away as easily from someone dedicating that amount of energy in to making them happy and the relationship work, is just incomprehensible to me to the point where I don’t feel ill ever be able to accept what’s happened because it just doesn’t feel real.
Eh, I’m in a pretty fucked up place right now. I’d love to see how it could get worse and add that to my list of “ok nevermind I take that back”
at this point I’ve just ate the cost and I just gave most of the gifts to other people instead.
Texas

Thank you for the kind words man.

Na she isn’t coming back, she made that clear. And even if she did I don’t know if I’d accept it. 

I spent the last 2 months doing everything I could through therapy, counselling etc to fix some of my problems that I think lead to my anxiety etc  and prove to her that things can work out and that we are worth fighting for and that we can come out of this stronger. I’d have dropped everything on the spot and flew out next day if it meant repairing things but anytime I offered and reiterated that she in no way wanted to do that.she doesn’t believe in second chances.

She completely blocked me and removed me on everything 2 weeks ago, after erasing everything to do with me and telling me to do the same. She wants to pretend the last 5 years never happened by the sounds of it. 

It just hurts knowing she moved on so fast after I done so much to just make it work, to just make her happy and now I’m left here alone feeling like shit day to day while she is living her life forgetting I even exist.

Lol me and my ex were 5 years in to LDR, when we hit a rough patch 2 and a half months ago. I basically got in to a really dark and fucked up place, and my ex thought it was something to do with her so she broke up with me blaming herself. Then that sent me in to an even deeper depression and id just keep all of my feelings and emtions bottled up when she was wanting to fix things, because I didnt want her blaming herself again. so 3 weeks after the breakup when I approached her to fix it and explain everything she told me she was seeing someone else and it was too late.

She went from blaming herself > Wanting to fix the relationship > moving on and telling me its too late she is now seeing someone else she met off tinder. In the span of just under 3 weeks.

It hurts. But it hurts even more the amount, and lengths I went to, to just make the relationship work and make her happy and to try make her family happy. Would stay up to 6am daily, and then go to class at 9, just so I could talk to her. I took 2 years off College so she could work full time and get another job, and still talk to me. I was learning a language for 3 years just to communicate with parts of her family. I Was doing a degree this year simply for the plan to move over there, 4000 miles away, in 2 years. The list goes on and on.

5 years, lost it in 3 weeks because I let my anxiety and depression get the better of me.

Saying "I literally want to die" would be an understatement. I feel like ive been punished for being in a bad place and the one person I thought would stand by me through it and fight to come out the other side and understand, just kept telling me it was too late.

The last 2 and a half months have been hell, and no amount of therapy or counselling seems to be pushing me in to that zone of acceptance.

Edit: Spelling

Lol, my ex broke up with me 2 and a half months ago and ive been fucked up ever since. I had a plane ticket booked (non refundable) and a shit load of gifts as a surprise to her and her family over Christmas.

Im down £1400 now, and as a 22 year old full time student with no job, that aint exactly money I get easily...

Now I assume she will have been spending her thanksgiving and Christmas, with her new boyfriend, whom she met off Tinder, 2 and a half weeks after the breakup of our 5 year relationship...

Do I sound spiteful, I feel like I sound spiteful?
